verdict.rationale: Weave clearly supports auto-instrumentation for OpenAI (and Anthropic, Cohere, Mistral, Hugging Face) via weave.op() decorators/wrappers and has a TypeScript wrap() function, satisfying the OpenAI-SDK part of the story, and it also supports generic OTel-based instrumentation for 'popular SDKs and harnesses.' However, no evidence pack citation explicitly names a LangChain integration or a Vercel AI SDK integration, so those specific framework integrations are unconfirmed. missing for 10: explicit documentation of a first-party LangChain integration, explicit documentation of a Vercel AI SDK integration.
